description: This file contains Express.js route handlers related to authentication and user account management in a backend server. It defines endpoints for user registration, login, profile update, OAuth via Azure AD, password reset, and fetching current user info, with integrated Swagger documentation for API specifications.

methods.name: router.post('/register')
methods.description: Handles user registration, validating input, hashing password, and storing new user with default 'learner' role, pending admin approval.

methods.name: router.post('/login')
methods.description: Authenticates user with email and password, issuing JWT token upon success, considering account status and provider.

methods.name: router.patch('/profile')
methods.description: Updates authenticated user's profile data including name and professional title.

methods.name: router.get('/me')
methods.description: Returns the profile of the currently authenticated user.

methods.name: router.post('/azure/find-or-create')
methods.description: Finds an existing user via Azure OAuth login or creates a new one with pending status.

methods.name: router.post('/forgot-password')
methods.description: Generates a password reset token for a user and updates their record; token is returned for development testing.

methods.name: router.post('/reset-password')
methods.description: Resets user password if provided token is valid and not expired.
